title: Antigen presentation requirements for effective cDC1-based cancer immunotherapy.
snippet: Type 1 conventional dendritic cells (cDC1s) are important for generating and sustaining antitumor immunity. Accordingly, the abundance of cDC1s in human tumors correlates with improved outcomes in cancer.
